_synthetic.note: Hand-built for T-2035 unit tests. The fdcId is outside any FoodData Central id range, the description and category are not USDA strings, and every number is invented - including the negative carbohydrate, which is NOT any real record's value. Real records do carry small negative 'Carbohydrate, by difference' figures because that quantity is 100 minus the other components; this fixture reproduces the shape, not any particular food. No source, no license, no retrieval date and no attribution is claimed.
